description: What one opportunity depends on: protocols, stablecoins and their issuers, oracles, bridges and vault curators, as a graph. Useful for finding hidden shared exposure before combining positions. The id comes from the free /api/v1/opportunities. Unknown ids answer 404 and invalid arguments 400 before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer. In this MCP server, ids come from search_opportunities.

id.description: Opportunity id, as returned by the free /api/v1/opportunities route.
